description: This file defines the GuzzleStream class which acts as an adapter converting a PSR-7 Stream to a Guzzle 5 Stream, facilitating interoperability between different HTTP message stream implementations.

classes.name: GuzzleStream
classes.description: Adapter class that implements Guzzle 5 Stream interface by wrapping a PSR-7 Stream.
